# VidCraft Studio Pro
> Zero-server Manifest V3 browser extension (Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Chrome) that transforms long and short videos across YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, Douyin, and HTML5 players into zero-omission, publication-grade Markdown, Standalone HTML, Vector PDF, and Native Word (.docx) documents with bespoke typography and clickable [MM:SS] playback links.

## Key URLs
- Homepage: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/
- YouTube to Zero-Omission Markdown & Word: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/youtube-to-markdown/
- Bilibili WBI Subtitle Extractor & Notes: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/bilibili-subtitle-extractor/
- TikTok & Douyin Audio Whisper Notes: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/tiktok-douyin-transcript/
- Video Lecture to Native Word (.docx) & PDF: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/video-to-word-docx/
- German (DACH) Overview: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/de/
- Live Generated Sample Report: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/showcase/distributed-consensus-report.html
- Privacy Policy: https://vidcraft-studio.pages.dev/privacy/
